encounterPose.note: a posed fight start: the least gap the hero and foe may start at (m), the pit marks' own gap that caps it (m, times the foe's spawn scale), and how far inside the wall they stay so float32 rounding never pushes one onto it (m)

encounterToken.note: an encounter token ends in this many random bytes (base64url, 4 characters per 3 bytes); a posed token's fight id is at most this many characters (the 128-character token cap)

worldKill.note: the world kill check: the share of the fastest possible kill time a report may undercut, the metres of slack on a creature's reach for presence's pose lag, and the oldest presence pose (ms) that still counts
